summary: Church CRUD, Announcements, Follow System, and Layout Sections testing complete. Backend: 40/40 tests passed (100%). All church management endpoints working correctly - CRUD operations, approval/rejection workflow, announcements CRUD, user follow/unfollow system with authentication, and layout sections supporting 'choirs' and 'churches' types.

minor.issue: Some singer records in database have 'followers' field instead of 'followers_count'. The Singer model defines 'followers_count' but old records may have 'followers'. This is a data inconsistency.

passed_tests: POST /api/churches - Create new church with all fields (name, denomination, location, address, city, country, direction, lat/lng, google_maps_url, bio, leader info, images, prayer_schedule, contact info)
GET /api/churches/{church_id} - Get single church with all fields
POST /api/churches/{church_id}/approve - Admin approve church (sets status=approved, approved_by, admin_notes)
POST /api/churches/{church_id}/reject - Admin reject church (sets status=rejected, admin_notes)
POST /api/churches/{church_id}/announcements - Create announcement (date, title, type, description, time, location, contact info, recurring)
POST /api/user/follow - Follow a church (requires auth, increments followers_count)
POST /api/user/follow - Follow a choir (requires auth, increments followers_count)
GET /api/user/following - Get user's followed entities (grouped by churches/choirs)
DELETE /api/user/unfollow - Unfollow entity (requires auth, decrements followers_count)
Verify followers_count incremented on church after follow
Verify followers_count incremented on singer after follow
action_items: Consider adding migration to update old singer records from 'followers' to 'followers_count' field for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: Church model correctly includes all required fields: images (thumbnail, cover_image, gallery_images), prayer_schedule (structured list), location details (lat/lng, google_maps_url), leader info, contact info
Church approval workflow correctly sets status, approved_by, approved_at, admin_notes
ChurchAnnouncement model includes auto-expiry (expires_at set to 2 weeks from date)
UserFollow model correctly tracks user_id, entity_type (church/choir/artist), entity_id with notifications_enabled flag
Follow/unfollow endpoints correctly increment/decrement followers_count on churches and singers
Layout sections support 'choirs' and 'churches' as section_type and content_type
SMS notifications are MOCKED - they log to database instead of sending real SMS
seed_data_creation: Test churches, singers, announcements, and user follows created during pytest run with TEST_church_* prefix. Cleanup runs after tests.
